info.title: HYRE Agent API
info.description: AI-enhanced DeFi data API. 24 endpoints with LLM-interpreted insights. Multi-chain x402 payment via PayAI facilitator: Solana (root paths), Base (/base/*), SKALE (/skale/*). All chains use sponsored gas. No API keys — payment is the only gate.
info.x-guidance:
HYRE Agent provides 24 DeFi intelligence endpoints across 5 segments. Three payment chains supported via x402, all routed through the PayAI facilitator (facilitator.payai.network):

**Solana:** Root paths (/, /trenches/*, /traders/*, etc.). Network solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp. Gas sponsored via PayAI feePayer 2wKupLR9q6wXYppw8Gr2NvWxKBUqm4PPJKkQfoxHDBg4.

**Base:** Prefixed /base/* paths (/base/trenches/*, /base/defi/*, etc.). Network eip155:8453.

**SKALE:** Prefixed /skale/* paths (/skale/trenches/*, /skale/defi/*, etc.). Network eip155:1187947933. Zero gas fees.

**ME Protocol agents (/agents/:name/*):** Each claimed .me agent proxies a subset of the catalog above. Calls to /agents/alice/trenches/verdict/<token> route payment to alice's Asset Signer PDA instead of HYRE's wallet. Template gating rejects endpoints the agent's template does not cover. See the /agents/{name} operation below for details.

All chains return identical AI-enriched data. Every response includes: data, insight, signal, confidence, model_used, latency_ms.

get.description: Dispatch a paid call scoped to a registered .me agent. `{name}` must be an active agent (see POST /agents/register). `{proxied_path}` is any of the catalog routes (e.g. `trenches/token/<mint>/verdict`). The path is matched against the agent's template allowlist: trench-hunter → /trenches/*; lp-strategist → /lps/*; trader-copy → /traders/*; defi-yield → /defi/* + /debridge/*; yield-farmer → /defi/* + /lps/*; nft-minter → none; custom → all. Unmatched paths return 403. Payment (x402 USDC on Solana) is routed to the agent owner's Asset Signer PDA, not the HYRE main wallet, so 100% of gross lands with the claimer before HYRE's off-chain infra-cost accounting. Every call is logged to `me_agent_events` keyed on the agent name and surfaced via GET /me-agent-stats/:name.

parameters.name: proxied_path
parameters.description: One of the catalog routes (e.g. trenches/token-verdict).

200.description: Downstream 2xx — identical shape to the proxied endpoint (HyreResponse).

402.description: Payment required — standard x402 challenge. Pay to the agent's Asset Signer PDA.

403.description: Template does not allow this endpoint for this agent.

404.description: Agent not registered or status != active.

post.summary: Register or update a ME Protocol agent
post.description: Called by the ME Protocol frontend after the claim flow completes (Solana NFT mint + SKALE ERC-8004 registration). Upserts a row into me_agents. Idempotent for the same (name, ownerWallet); 409 if another wallet owns the name. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <ME_PROTOCOL_API_KEY>`.

assetSignerPda.description: Precomputed PDA — payout recipient for all paid calls.

409.description: Name already claimed by a different wallet.

503.description: ME_PROTOCOL_API_KEY not configured on this deployment.

get.description: [SKALE] Dispatch a paid call scoped to a registered .me agent. `{name}` must be an active agent (see POST /agents/register). `{proxied_path}` is any of the catalog routes (e.g. `trenches/token/<mint>/verdict`). The path is matched against the agent's template allowlist: trench-hunter → /trenches/*; lp-strategist → /lps/*; trader-copy → /traders/*; defi-yield → /defi/* + /debridge/*; yield-farmer → /defi/* + /lps/*; nft-minter → none; custom → all. Unmatched paths return 403. Payment (x402 USDC on Solana) is routed to the agent owner's Asset Signer PDA, not the HYRE main wallet, so 100% of gross lands with the claimer before HYRE's off-chain infra-cost accounting. Every call is logged to `me_agent_events` keyed on the agent name and surfaced via GET /me-agent-stats/:name.

parameters.name: proxied_path
parameters.description: One of the catalog routes (e.g. trenches/token-verdict).

200.description: Downstream 2xx — identical shape to the proxied endpoint (HyreResponse).

402.description: Payment required — standard x402 challenge. Pay to the agent's Asset Signer PDA.

403.description: Template does not allow this endpoint for this agent.

404.description: Agent not registered or status != active.

post.summary: Register or update a ME Protocol agent
post.description: [SKALE] Called by the ME Protocol frontend after the claim flow completes (Solana NFT mint + SKALE ERC-8004 registration). Upserts a row into me_agents. Idempotent for the same (name, ownerWallet); 409 if another wallet owns the name. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <ME_PROTOCOL_API_KEY>`.

assetSignerPda.description: Precomputed PDA — payout recipient for all paid calls.

409.description: Name already claimed by a different wallet.

503.description: ME_PROTOCOL_API_KEY not configured on this deployment.
